messages:
Maria Chen: Paging: high 5xx rate on inference-rt-prod starting ~10:12 UTC. Alert from perf-alerts: model-runner processes crashing with SIGSEGV / OOM in zones us-west1-a/b and us-east1-b. Seeing repeated OOM kill logs and 5xx spikes on gateway.

IncidentBot: Alert created: perf-alerts#2137 -> 5xx-rate >= 8% for 5m on route /v1/generate (prod). Notified on-call.

Ian (SRE): On-call here. Can someone post scope (customers impacted / % traffic) and recent logs? Do we have a recent change/rollout in runtime or model weights?

Alex Perez: rolling back no recent model push. We did push a runtime patch yesterday to kernel prefetch settings. I'm going to open a routing mitigation: split traffic to fallback quantized variant and enable fallback pool. Command I'm using:
```
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/generate --policy "fallback=quant-v2@30%" --force
```
I'll also throttle new long-sync batch jobs.

Lina Gomez: digging into runner logs — frequent segfaults in model-runner binary at kv_cache.cpp:line 482. Stack shows memcpy after allocation. Also several nodes show high RSS + swap activity then kernel oom_killer invoked. Suspect regression in cache growth code under long contexts.

Maria Chen: Customer impact: OLIVER-analytics and two small PLG customers reporting 502/504s via support. Estimated 9% of prod requests saw 5xx in the last 10m. I'm posting status to status.redwood.ai and tagging CS.

Olivia (CS): Confirmed: OLIVER-analytics sees spike 10:15-10:22 UTC, their dashboard shows timeouts; they've put a hotfix flag to route to provider fallback. Sharing contact for escalation.

Ian (SRE): Immediate mitigations: (1) Apply routing split (Alex) — done. (2) Scale up dedicated runner-pool by 30% to reduce queueing: 
```
infra scale pool runner-prod --add-nodes 6 --type g4-x
```
(3) On nodes with repeated segfaults, restart model-runner process gracefully and cordon the node from autoscaler. Lina, can you push a hotfix to disable the cache growth path and build a debug image?

Lina Gomez: Building hotfix now. Will disable adaptive cache growth (#disable-adaptive-cache) and add extra logging. Pushing image to canary group, will promote if clean. Also setting ulimit -v lower to fail fast and reduce OOM blast radius.

Maria Chen: After routing + scale + node restarts, error rate dropped from ~12% to ~3% within 8 minutes. Still seeing intermittent 5xx in us-west1-a; keeping page open. Notifying account teams. Handing off to Ian (night oncall) at 18:00 UTC — will attach logs and runbook. Postmortem owner: Lina.

Ian (SRE): Handoff ack. I'll monitor for 2 hours then escalate if regressions. Please add any customers impacted to the incident doc. Also we should run a targeted eval on quant-v2 outputs for quality regression before long-term routing.

Maria Chen: adding links: incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/2315009999, status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2315009999. Good work team :thumbsup: 

IncidentBot: Incident updated: severity -> P2; timeline and mitigations logged. Reminder: create postmortem within 72 hours.
